arStrings.szText: Heroes rise amid the folly of fools.

The Zelos are sacrificing the children to a demon named Kakkos—which confused Tymon, who says Kakkos is a demon of mischief, not sacrifice. He ran ahead to Kakkos' shrine in the north, fixed to stop the Zelos' madness.

I must save Tymon and the children before they fall victim to the Zelos.

I must save Tymon and the children before they fall victim to the Zelos.

Dolos and I felled the Zelos, burying their madness and cowardice with them. Tymon did not survive, but his courage helped see their end.

I have questions for Dolos—the demon previously known as Kakkos—and the fate of the children.
